binning.argmax: highest-probability bin; provider choice breaks ties

calories.instructions: Estimate total kilocalories for the specified serving; choose the range containing the total. Ranges include the lower edge and exclude the upper edge.

protein.instructions: Estimate total grams of protein for the specified serving; choose the range containing the total. Ranges include the lower edge and exclude the upper edge.

carbs.instructions: Estimate total grams of total carbohydrate for the specified serving; choose the range containing the total. Ranges include the lower edge and exclude the upper edge.

fat.instructions: Estimate total grams of total fat for the specified serving; choose the range containing the total. Ranges include the lower edge and exclude the upper edge.

protocol.catastrophicDefinition: calorie absolute percentage error > 50; failures and omissions are misses
protocol.failureMedian: positive infinity; non-finite median serialized as null
